findings.title: 'joint' exposure is P(all of K skipped) = product of p_l, not the exact skip pattern (e.g. 0.15 vs 0.1275 for 2,1)
findings.fix: Document joint as 'all levels in K skipped; other frozen levels may also have been skipped'; optionally add exact_pattern = prod(p_l) * prod(1 - p_m) for run frozen levels. Rules stay on joint.

findings.title: Content of predict.json 'levels' in error records not specified when no plan exists (level not in checkpoint); assignment order vs the refusal raise implicit
findings.fix: Assign rec['levels'] = plan.to_dict() (with exposure) before raising the refusal; for a bad level write {requested, checkpoint_levels, selected: null}; null if _peek_config failed.

findings.title: Insertion point of plan/exposure in _run_check unspecified (_peek_config is called inline in _check_unchunked)
findings.fix: peek = _peek_config(...); build plan + exposure (refusal); _check_unchunked(n, peek, ...); all before _read_subjects.
